title: Potato Pavé With Parmesan Crust
description: A rich, elegant layered potato terrine baked in cream and butter, chilled, then seared with a crispy Parmesan crust.

ingredients.name: canola oil
ingredients.quantity: 1/4 to 1/3 cup, as needed for searing

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350°F and prepare a 9-inch loaf pan by greasing it and lining it with parchment paper.
Melt the butter in a small saucepan, then whisk in the heavy cream, salt, and black pepper.
Peel the potatoes and slice them into 1/8-inch thick rounds using a mandoline or sharp knife.
Toss the sliced potatoes in the cream mixture until evenly coated.
Layer the potato slices in the loaf pan, pressing down occasionally to compact the layers.
Fold the parchment over the potatoes, cover tightly with foil, and bake for 2 hours until tender.
Remove from the oven, uncover, and let steam escape for 15 minutes.
Weight the terrine down with a flat object and heavy cans, then let cool completely for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Rewrap tightly and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or up to 3 days.
Remove the chilled terrine from the pan, trim the edges, and cut into 12 equal rectangular pieces.
Let the pieces sit at room temperature for 15 to 30 minutes.
Heat canola oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Dip the two largest sides of each potato piece into the grated Parmesan.
Sear the Parmesan-coated sides in batches for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and crisp.
Transfer to paper towels, sprinkle with flaky sea salt, and serve immediately.
